 'You are a Silver member. For your economy class reservation with two passengers, as a Silver member, you are allowed 2 free checked bags per passenger.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to know exactly how many suitcases I’m allowed to bring on my upcoming flight. I have a lot to pack, so I really need the correct number. Can you help me with that?

I can help you with that. To provide the exact number of suitcases you are allowed to bring, I need to know your user ID or some details about your upcoming flight reservation, such as the reservation ID or the flight details. Could you please provide that information?

Sure, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901 and my confirmation number is JMO1MG. Let me know if you need anything else. I just really need to know the total number of suitcases I can take, in a number, please.

You have a one-way economy class reservation for two passengers. As an economy class passenger with your membership level (not specified, assuming regular), you are allowed 1 free checked bag per passenger. So, you can bring a total of 2 free checked bags for your flight. If you need to bring more bags, there will be an additional charge of $50 per extra bag.

If you want, I can help you add more checked bags to your reservation. Would you like to do that? If yes, please specify how many additional bags you want to add.

Thank you for checking, but I’m pretty sure I’m a Gold member. Can you confirm my membership status and let me know the total number of suitcases I can bring, as an exact number? It’s really important to me that this is correct. I need to see the number, not just words.

You are a Silver member. For your economy class reservation with two passengers, as a Silver member, you are allowed 2 free checked bags per passenger. 

So, the total number of free checked bags you can bring is 4.

If you want to bring more than 4 bags, each additional bag will cost $50. Let me know if you want to add extra bags to your reservation.
I’m sorry, but I really believe I’m a Gold member, not Silver. Can you please transfer me to a supervisor so I can get this clarified? This is very important to me.
